points.point: Aerospace / Defense 市場需求：在不修改 DUT 的前提下，讓 deployed private 5G 連線對 smart jamming 更有韌性（tactical edge、軍事基地 private 5G、secure C2 等 driver）
points.label: covered
points.why: states unmodified DUT, smart-jamming/contested RF, network-side resilience for mission-critical private 5G

points.point: 此需求出自 R&S Aerospace & Defense Test 的業務脈絡（簡報封面列名 Business Development Manager, Aerospace & Defense Test）
points.label: partial
points.why: ties source to A&D Test context, but omits Business Development Manager cover detail

points.point: 可量測參數：RRC reconfiguration 造成的 UE data interruption gap 被定義為 HO interruption interval
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions HO interruption interval, but not its definition as UE data interruption gap caused by RRC reconfiguration

points.point: 量測結果門檻：最差情境（每秒跳頻、target cell 未預先啟用）下 data interruptions 在 99% 時間低於 75 ms
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions 75 ms-related results, but not the worst-case 1 s hopping / no target preactivation condition with 99% below 75 ms

points.point: 該參數對應到 mission-critical 需求判準：3GPP 5QI 的 mission-critical push-to-talk voice 75 ms at 99% reliability
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention 3GPP 5QI mission-critical push-to-talk 75 ms at 99% reliability criterion

points.point: signaling tester 必要能力（硬體面）：CMX500 作為 5G network emulator，需 two NR FR1 RF units、four RF ports、up to eight cells，並同時部署 n41 / n78 / n79 三個 5G SA cells
points.label: covered
points.why: lists CMX500 emulator, two NR FR1 RF units, four RF ports, up to eight cells, and n41/n78/n79 cells

points.point: signaling tester 必要能力（signaling 面）：須能在 UE 沒有 target cell RSRP measurements 的情況下強制執行 handover（late / dynamic target cell activation）
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions target cell not preactivated, but not handover without target cell RSRP measurements / late dynamic target activation capability

points.point: 航太（衛星）側平行鏈條：NTN space-to-ground effects（Doppler、delay、scattering）要求 tester 區分 propagation emulation 與 fading；eco-chain mapping 把 UT 的 NB-NTN / NR-NTN 需求對應到 CMX500 與 CMP180
points.label: missing
points.why: does not cover NTN Doppler/delay/scattering, propagation vs fading distinction, or UT NB-NTN/NR-NTN mapping to CMX500 and CMP180

invented: Smart jammer 被描述為會追蹤 used frequency、在 specific moments 發射 noise
